remarks: This stunning colonial sits on 4 acres complete w private pond, former horse stable and level lawn. Borders a 200+acre nature preserve home to many Greenwich Riding Trails & walking / hiking trails. The 5 bed 4.2 bath home welcomes you with natural light and so much space! Double island eat-in kitchen flows through sunroom into family room Library is perfect Home Office with vaulted ceiling, 3 exposures, wet bar and .5 bath. In-law suite accessed by separate staircase provides privacy for guests Media room & gym downstairs Heated 2 car garage with 15' workbench. Bonus wine room in the basement can store 1600 bottles! Recently replaced septic pump, boiler, oil tanks, whole-home generator, and electrical panels. Zoned for Parkway Elementary and Central Middle schools.
